channel.title: Veronica Hub Changelog
channel.description: Resident Evil Veronica official update tracker official-source change feed.

item.title: Watchlist and RSS tracking layer added
item.description: Added a Watchlist page, RSS feed generation from changelog records and a source monitoring script that creates human-review items before claim changes. Affected: watchlist, changelog, source-monitoring. Source: Veronica Hub source policy (/sources/).

item.title: Veronica Hub page plan created
item.description: Planning documents define the site structure, source policy, measurement checklist and update roadmap. Affected: announcement-status, release-window, exact-release-date. Source: Veronica Hub source policy (/sources/).

item.title: Expanded playable reference catalog with pre-2000 RE era titles
item.description: Added original and early-series Resident Evil titles plus additional clip search references so visitors can compare pacing before judging Veronica. Affected: media-page. Source: Veronica Hub source policy (/sources/).

item.title: Homepage visual direction improved
item.description: The homepage hero and official media presentation were refined while preserving the lead heroine background. Affected: official-trailer. Source: Veronica Hub source policy (/sources/).

item.title: Steam page is live
item.description: Steam lists Resident Evil Veronica with CAPCOM as developer and publisher and a planned 2027 release year. Affected: steam-page, developer-publisher, pc-requirements. Source: Steam store (https://store.steampowered.com/app/4824610/Resident_Evil_Veronica/).

item.title: Capcom announces Resident Evil Veronica for 2027
item.description: Capcom announces Resident Evil Veronica as a remake with a 2027 release window and confirmed platform set. Affected: announcement-status, release-window, confirmed-platforms. Source: Capcom press release (https://www.capcom.co.jp/ir/english/news/html/e260608.html).
